name: services/housing/dormroom_type
description:
Get information on a single dormroom type.

Dormitory rooms come in various standards and sizes. USOS defines a couple of room types, which roughly describe their size and standard.
brief_description: Get information on a single dormroom type

arguments.name: dormroom_type_id
arguments.description: ID of the type of room

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of selected fields and their values.

Available fields:

  • id - ID of this type;

  • name - LangDict with a name of this type of room.

    In the majority of cases names will be reasonable short (e.g. "single rooms" or "quadruple room with bunk beds"). However, in theory, they may be even 200 characters long!

result_fields.name: name
result_fields.description: In the majority of cases names will be reasonable short (e.g. "single rooms" or "quadruple room with bunk beds"). However, in theory, they may be even 200 characters long!
